Name: Vanilla Tweaks Style Seedbags for Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2 (Unofficial)
Author: shimiroll
Description:
Hi :) If you use both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16999]Quaint Living - Flower Garden 2[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21284]Vanilla Tweaks - Farming Edition[/url] and want more consistency for your seed bags, this mod is for you!

Future goals:[list]
[*] Improve art more
[*] More differentiation for saplings
[*] Maybe make original art for the flower seeds that I only lightly edited from FG2 (I did not make new flower art for seeds that already fit the VT seed bags well as they are all already very pretty, it's just that the pixel real estates were different between the mods)
[/list]
